newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen up on Wall Street rise.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen up on Wall Street rise.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are expected to rebound on Wednesday, with sentiment seen improving in blue chips following the overnight jump in the Dow, brokers said.
The Dow industrials posted their second-largest point rise ever on Tuesday after weaker-than-expected U.S. wage inflation data soothed concerns about rising interest rates, brokers said.
"The Dow's jump is likely to boost sentiment, particularly on big-caps, after the sharp fall in the Jakarta index yesterday," one broker said.
On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index fell 9.30 points to close at 647.23 points on heavy profit-taking, brokers said.

Brokers said the market focus was likely to remain on small property firm Elang following reports that the Bakrie Group, which has a majority stake in Elang, planned to place its property projects under Elang.
Newly-listed Multidana was also likely to remain a market focus, but any possible upside for the finance firm was seen limited after its strong debut on Monday, brokers said.
